newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gencor may manage gold assets by time zone.
newsitem.headline: Gencor may manage gold assets by time zone.

text.p: Mining group Gencor Ltd said on Thursday it was planning to re-arrange the management of its gold assets along time zones as an alternative to the current system using offices in Johannesburg, London and Jersey.
"Over the next four years we want to group our assets along time zones," Gencor director Bobby Jurd told a media conference.
Jurd said that while improved communication technologies had eased the burden on management, the spread of gold assets had forced the company to reconsider the management structure.

"We've got assets in in six countries in South America, Indonesia and Africa and we just find it extremely difficult to manage across these zones and that's why we are looking at how to group these assets," he said.
Jurd said Gencor was looking at at establishing new offices around the world which might fit into the time zone management plan.
He said the group had no definite management formula.
"It's in flux, we've got no definite leads. All we know is what we've got now doesn't work."
Jurd declined to comment on recent reports the group was planning to list its base metals interests in London.
